verdict.rationale: Eqvista's first-party docs say its waterfall modeling runs distribution scenarios across share classes and stakeholder groups. A community user separately praises the waterfall analysis feature, and the product supports issuing preferred shares that such a model would draw on. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the waterfall honors liquidation preferences and participation rights, documented inputs for multiple exit values, and in-depth support docs or hands-on walkthroughs of waterfall output.
